title: Outer ring comment says 180°/8-position offset, code uses +4 (90°)
evidence:
+	// tier 3 double light ring: an outer LED ring (smaller LEDs) — the
+	// switch-fabric read (A3: "double light ring, larger"). The outer ring is
+	// offset by 8 positions on the 16-gon (180°): at any angle there is ONE
+	// LED (inner OR outer radius) alternating around the puck.
+	if port_capacity >= 16 {
+		for i in 0..<leds {
+			k := (i*stride + 4) % 16 // 180° opposite the inner ring's LED
detail: Comment claims the outer ring is offset "by 8 positions on the 16-gon (180°)" with ONE LED per angle; code uses +4 (90°), and 16 outer + 16 inner LEDs occupy every position.
recommended_fix: Change the offset to +8 to match the comment, or fix the comment to +4/90° and delete the "alternating" claim — geometrically false with 16 outer LEDs.

title: High-ceiling test spawns a house on the router's own tile (i=8 → {20,26})
evidence:
+	// high: houses in a row at its own y, x=4..36 — max span 16 <= wide max 18
+	high_type, _ := node_type_index(cat, "router_high")
+	high := topology_spawn_node(&s.topology, high_type, {20, 26}, cat)
+	for i in 0 ..< 17 {
+		hid := topology_spawn_node(&s.topology, res_type, {4 + i32(i) * 2, 26}, cat)
detail: House loop x = 4+2i hits x=20 at i=8 — the high router's tile — so the 9th pipe is zero-span and two live nodes share one tile, contradicting the 'max span 16' comment.
recommended_fix: Skip x=20 in the house row (offset the router or the row) so no node overlaps the router; correct the max-span comment to match.

title: Type-index bounds guard checks only the upper bound; negative index unguarded
detail: The guard continues only when the index exceeds the catalog length; if node_type is signed and negative, the slice index below still panics — contradicting the comment's 'must not panic the render pass' promise.
recommended_fix: Add a lower-bound check (e.g. also reject indices < 0) or make node_type unsigned so negative indices are impossible.
